$comment: Researched study options (Europe, Asia, Oceania, North America; 13 and 22 Nov 2026): scholarships with expected dates and self-funded guides. Inserted once when missing (by seedKey); empty fields of saved rows are filled from here, never overwritten. verified=false: check the official page.

programs.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
programs.funding: Tuition waived; monthly stipend about HUF 43,700 (~€110); free dormitory place or HUF 40,000/month towards rent; medical insurance.
programs.costs: Living costs above the stipend (budget for food and travel).
programs.howToApply: Two steps, both needed: (1) apply on the Hungarian DreamApply portal (up to two programmes), (2) get nominated by the Bangladesh Ministry of Education (sending partner). English proof: each university decides; many accept an MOI letter or the Duolingo test, so ask the universities you choose.
programs.notes: Facts from a 2026 application guide, not the official page: check stipendiumhungaricum.hu before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Application portal opens (expected)
Find the Bangladesh Ministry of Education nomination steps and their deadline
DreamApply application deadline, 14:00 CET (expected)

programs.workWhileStudying: Up to 30 hours a week during term; in vacations at most 90 days / 66 working days (ELTE).

programs.name: Türkiye Burslari (Türkiye Scholarships)
programs.funding: Tuition, monthly stipend, free dormitory, health insurance, one return flight, one-year Turkish language course.
programs.howToApply: One online application on the official portal (TBBS). No English test needed for most programmes; a one-year Turkish course comes first. Minimum grades in guides: 70% for bachelor, 75% for master.
programs.notes: Not in the EU, a good second option. Dates from a 2027 guide: confirm on the official site.

programs.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
programs.funding: Full scholarship: €1,400 per month for up to 24 months, tuition and insurance covered.
programs.howToApply: Pick programmes in the official catalogue and apply to each programme separately on its own website. Each programme sets its English rule: some accept an English-taught bachelor's degree, others want a test. Ask each programme before applying.
programs.notes: Very competitive; apply to several programmes that match your BSc subject.

deadlines.label: Choose programmes in the catalogue (most deadlines are October–January)

programs.name: Italy: public universities + regional DSU scholarship
programs.funding: Regional DSU scholarship by family income: fee waiver (full or 50%), money per year, free meals. Applied for after admission.
programs.costs: Living costs; the scholarship needs family income documents from Bangladesh.
programs.howToApply: 1) Get admitted to an English-taught programme (each university has its own deadline and English rule; many accept an MOI letter). 2) Pre-enrolment for the visa. 3) Apply for the regional DSU scholarship (Milan 2026: 10 July – 30 September).
programs.notes: Admission deadlines for non-EU students are often early in the year; check each university.

deadlines.label: Check admission deadlines of the Italian universities you like
DSU scholarship application (Milan, if like 2026)

programs.name: Austria: public universities (English-taught)
programs.funding: No large scholarship for full degrees found; low tuition instead.
programs.costs: Tuition €726.72 per semester for non-EU students; living about €850–1,200 a month; proof of funds needed for the visa.
programs.howToApply: Apply to each university. Many accept a letter from your university confirming English was the language of instruction instead of IELTS; check each programme.
programs.notes: Affordable, but without a scholarship you need money for living costs.

deadlines.label: Check winter-semester 2027 application deadlines of chosen universities

programs.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)
programs.funding: €10,800 for one academic year (9 months), paid quarterly. 2026 call; Bangladesh was an eligible country (citizens living there).
programs.costs: Tuition depends on the Italian university; ask whether a fee waiver is possible.
programs.howToApply: Choose a participating master's or postgraduate course, then apply online in the IYT window. English: B2 or higher; the 2026 call says a university certificate that your degree was taught in English may be accepted as proof.
programs.notes: Official 2026 call (Art. 3.4 on English): window was 20 April – 11 May 2026. The 2027 dates are expected to be similar. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: IYT call expected to open
IYT application deadline, 18:00 Italian time (expected)

programs.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
programs.funding: Monthly allowance €1,200 for master's (from January 2026), plus travel, insurance and housing help. Tuition is not covered.
programs.costs: Tuition at public French universities for non-EU students; living costs above the allowance in Paris.
programs.howToApply: You cannot apply alone: apply to a French master's programme first and ask that university to nominate you for Eiffel. Each university has its own earlier internal deadline. English: the French university decides (ask whether your MOI letter is accepted).
programs.notes: Institutions submit to Campus France by 6 January 2027 (third-party report of the 2027 call); results around the week of 12 April 2027. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Ask your French university for its internal Eiffel deadline
Universities send nominations to Campus France (expected)

programs.name: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
programs.funding: Full tuition, SEK 12,000 per month, travel grant. Bangladesh is on the eligible list (third-party report of the 2027 call).
programs.costs: Without the scholarship, Swedish tuition for non-EU students is high.
programs.howToApply: Two steps: apply to a master's on universityadmissions.se (round usually closes mid-January), then apply to SI with your application number. Needs leadership and work experience. English: Swedish admissions ask for English 6; check universityadmissions.se whether your Bangladeshi degree counts, otherwise an English test is needed.
programs.notes: SI deadline 24 February 2027 from a third-party report. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: universityadmissions.se master's round deadline (expected)
SI scholarship application deadline (expected)

programs.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
programs.funding: €10,000 for one year plus a full fee waiver from the university. About 60 awards.
programs.costs: Living costs in Ireland are high (Dublin especially).
programs.howToApply: First get an offer (conditional is fine) for a full-time master's at an Irish university, then apply to GOI-IES. The scholarship call sets no English test; the university's own admission rules decide.
programs.notes: 2026 deadline was 12 March 2026, 17:00 Irish time (official call). 2027 expected similar. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Apply to Irish master's programmes to have an offer in time
GOI-IES application deadline (expected)

programs.workWhileStudying: Up to 20 hours a week during term and 40 hours a week in the main holidays.

programs.name: NL Scholarship (Holland Scholarship)
programs.funding: €5,000 in the first year; not full tuition. For non-EEA students at participating universities.
programs.costs: Dutch tuition for non-EU students is high; the €5,000 covers only part.
programs.howToApply: Apply to the programme and to the scholarship through the university; each sets its own deadline (often 1 February or 1 May). English: most Dutch universities ask for IELTS/TOEFL from Bangladeshi applicants; ask each one.
programs.notes: Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Check each Dutch university's NL Scholarship deadline (often 1 February)

programs.name: Romanian Government Scholarships (MFA)
programs.funding: Romanian state scholarship for non-EU citizens incl. Bangladesh (tuition-free study; check the call for allowance).
programs.costs: Bachelor's and master's are taught in Romanian: a Romanian-language preparatory year comes first.
programs.howToApply: Apply on the Study in Romania portal. Needs a good academic average. Programmes in Romanian (prep year first); some PhDs in English.
programs.notes: 2025 window was 29 January – 12 March 2025 (UNB report). 2027 dates expected similar. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.costs: Check the guidelines for the monthly stipend.
programs.howToApply: For Bangladesh only English-taught programmes. You take an online English entrance test as part of the application (no IELTS mentioned).
programs.notes: The 2027/28 round closed on 30 September 2026. Next round (for 2028/29) expected to open late August 2027. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Chevening Scholarship
programs.funding: Tuition (up to a limit), monthly living allowance, return flight, visa costs.
programs.costs: Needs at least 2,800 hours of work experience before applying.
programs.howToApply: Apply to Chevening and to three UK master's courses; you need one unconditional offer by the Chevening deadline. Chevening itself has no English requirement since 2020, but the UK university decides (many accept English-medium degrees from Bangladesh; ask).
programs.notes: The 2027/28 round closed on 6 October 2026. Next round (2028/29) expected to open early August 2027. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarship
programs.funding: Fully funded one-year master's in the UK. Bangladesh is eligible.
programs.howToApply: Not a direct application: you are nominated by the national nominating agency (University Grants Commission of Bangladesh), then apply to the CSC. The CSC requires no IELTS; universities may have their own rules.
programs.notes: The 2027 round closed on 20 October 2026. Watch the UGC Bangladesh call in mid-2027 for 2028 entry. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: DAAD EPOS (development-related master's)
programs.funding: About €992 per month for master's students, plus travel and insurance (2027/28 guide).
programs.howToApply: For people from developing countries (OECD DAC list; Bangladesh is on it). Usually needs about two years of work experience after the bachelor's. You apply to the participating German university's course, not to DAAD; each course sets its own deadline (most between August and October). English: the course decides; many ask for a test, some accept an English-medium degree.
programs.notes: The 2027/28 round mostly closed in autumn 2026; the next one is for 2028/29. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Universities in Germany (self-funded)
programs.funding: Most public universities charge no tuition (Baden-Württemberg charges non-EU students per semester); a semester fee applies everywhere.
programs.costs: A blocked account for living costs is needed for the student visa.
programs.howToApply: Apply directly or through uni-assist, depending on the university. Some universities accept an English-medium degree as English proof; many ask for IELTS/TOEFL. Ask each university.
programs.notes: Typical deadlines: 15 January (summer semester) and 15 July (winter semester), but they differ. Collected from secondary sources on 13 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) – Embassy track
programs.funding: Full: tuition, monthly allowance, one-way flight, and one year of Korean language study before the degree (a master's scholarship lasts 1 + 2 years). Bangladesh had 7 embassy-track places in 2026.
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.workWhileStudying: Master's students: up to 15 hours a week without TOPIK level 4, up to 30 with it; no limit at weekends and in vacations with TOPIK 3. You need a job offer and government permission before starting (Korea JoongAng Daily, Oct 2026). GKS scholars: check the GKS rules first.
programs.howToApply: Apply online on Study in Korea during the embassy-track window; the Korean Embassy in Dhaka makes the first selection. You choose up to three universities. No English test is required (a test score only adds points); TOPIK 3+ adds 10% bonus points. CGPA must be at least 2.64/4.0; age under 40. Transcripts and degree certificate need attestation/apostille: start early.
programs.notes: 2026 window was 12–25 February 2026 (official 2026 GKS-G guideline). 2027 expected similar. Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Prepare GKS papers: attested transcripts, 2 recommendation letters, personal statement, study plan
GKS embassy-track window expected to open
GKS embassy-track deadline (expected)

programs.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) – University track
programs.funding: Same benefits as the embassy track. Bangladesh had 20 university-track places in 2026 (3 general, 17 R-GKS for regional universities).
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.workWhileStudying: Master's students: up to 15 hours a week without TOPIK level 4, up to 30 with it; no limit at weekends and in vacations with TOPIK 3. You need a job offer and government permission before starting (Korea JoongAng Daily, Oct 2026). GKS scholars: check the GKS rules first.
programs.howToApply: Apply directly to ONE Korean university that takes GKS university-track applicants; each sets its own deadline (usually February–March). You cannot apply to both tracks in the same year. Regional universities (R-GKS) have more places and less competition.
programs.notes: Documents of selected candidates go to NIIED by 1 May (2026). Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Check Korean universities' GKS university-track deadlines (most February–March)

programs.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
programs.funding: Tuition paid to the university plus RM 1,500 a month (paid every four months after a progress report). Master's and PhD.
programs.costs: Tuition covered; living costs in Malaysia are low compared with Europe.
programs.workWhileStudying: Only during semester breaks longer than 7 days, at most 20 hours a week, in restaurants, mini-markets, hotels or petrol stations, with the university's approval; no work during term. No general post-study work visa.
programs.howToApply: Apply online on the MOHE portal. CGPA at least 3.00 (or second class upper); age 40 or under. English: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 550, OR an official declaration from your university that your degree was taught in English. Eligibility: citizens of listed countries incl. Commonwealth countries in Asia — confirm Bangladesh with international@mohe.gov.my.
programs.notes: The 2026 call opened in spring 2026; 2027 dates not announced yet. Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.howToApply: Apply on campuschina.org under the bilateral programme (Type A) for Bangladesh, choosing up to three universities; then submit the printed papers as the Embassy asks. Pick English-taught master's; English proof is set by the university (many accept an English-medium certificate). A physical examination form is required.
programs.notes: The 2027-28 round is open with deadline 10 January 2027 (bdnews24, 18 Nov 2026). Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.funding: Same benefits as Type A; the Chinese university selects you.

programs.workWhileStudying: Part-time work needs the university's and immigration's approval; options are limited.
programs.howToApply: Apply to a Chinese university that takes CGS Type B applicants (programme code from the university), on campuschina.org and the university's own portal. Deadlines differ (often January–April). Contacting a professor first helps.

programs.name: MEXT Scholarship (Japan) – Embassy recommendation, research students
programs.funding: Japanese government scholarship: tuition, monthly allowance and flights.
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.workWhileStudying: Usually up to 28 hours a week (8 hours a day in long vacations) with a "permission to engage in activity other than that permitted" from immigration — general rule, check before you start.
programs.howToApply: Applications go to the Ministry of Education, Bangladesh (not the Embassy). Document screening, then written exams in English and Japanese and an interview. You study in the same or a related field (Computer Science). Age limit: for the 2027 round, born on or after 2 April 1992.
programs.notes: The 2027 round is closed; the 2028 round is expected around April–May 2027. Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Watch for the MEXT 2028 call (Embassy of Japan, Dhaka)

programs.name: MEXT Scholarship (Japan) – University recommendation
programs.funding: Same MEXT benefits; the Japanese university nominates you.
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.workWhileStudying: Usually up to 28 hours a week (8 hours a day in long vacations) with a "permission to engage in activity other than that permitted" from immigration — general rule, check before you start.
programs.howToApply: Apply to an English-taught graduate programme at a Japanese university that offers MEXT university-recommendation places; deadlines are set by each university (often a year before the start). A professor's acceptance usually helps.

programs.costs: Tokyo is expensive; regional cities cost less.
programs.workWhileStudying: Usually up to 28 hours a week (8 hours a day in long vacations) with a "permission to engage in activity other than that permitted" from immigration — general rule, check before you start.
programs.howToApply: English-taught graduate programmes set their own English rules; research students usually contact a professor first.
programs.notes: Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Universities in Taiwan (university scholarships)
programs.funding: Many universities give international students tuition waivers and monthly stipends. The government MOE Taiwan Scholarship is offered through Taiwan's offices per country; no Bangladesh guide was found.
programs.costs: Lower living costs than Japan or Korea.
programs.workWhileStudying: Up to 20 hours a week during term with a work permit, unlimited in winter and summer vacations — general rule, check.
programs.howToApply: Apply directly to universities (application usually December–March for the autumn intake). English-taught programmes usually ask for IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL; ask whether an English-medium certificate is enough.
programs.notes: Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

programs.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
programs.funding: New Zealand government scholarship: tuition, living allowance, flights, insurance.
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.howToApply: Check first whether Bangladesh is an eligible country this year. Applications are online; the 2026 round was open 1 March – 10 April 2026 (University of Otago). An English test is usually required.
programs.notes: Collected on 22 Nov 2026; check the official page before relying on dates and amounts.

deadlines.label: Manaaki: check eligibility and the 2027 round dates

programs.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Bangladesh)
programs.funding: Full tuition, flights, living allowance, health cover.
programs.costs: Covered by the scholarship.
programs.workWhileStudying: Up to 48 hours per fortnight during study periods, unlimited in scheduled breaks — general rule, check the current visa conditions.
programs.howToApply: Needs at least four years of full-time relevant work experience, IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0), and a bachelor's equal to an Australian one — a published intake guide said degrees from private Bangladeshi universities are generally not considered equivalent. Applications are usually open February–April.
